item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00418","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C10","C06","C07"],"selected_candidate_label":"C10","confidence":0.97,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C10 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. Both directives use the same compact sequence: establish a presidentially appointed committee and chairman; direct consultation with relevant defense and civilian officials; request government agencies to cooperate and furnish needed information; and assign the committee's necessary expenses, expressly including member compensation, to named agencies. The close language and provision-by-provision alignment materially exceed generic committee boilerplate. C06 and C07 share the establishment and agency-cooperation provisions but lack C10's distinctive consultation-plus-expense sequence.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"There is hereby established the National Advisory Committee ... which shall be composed of such members as may be appointed by the President, and the chairman of which shall be designated by the President.","parent_excerpt":"There is hereby established the President's Committee ... and not less than seven other members who shall be appointed by the President. The President shall designate one of the members of the Committee as Chairman thereof.","explanation":"Closely parallel committee-creation, presidential-appointment, and chairman-designation machinery."},{"child_excerpt":"the Committee shall consult with the Director of Selective Service and with such other officials and agencies as may be necessary, including the Secretary of Defense and appropriate officials of the Departments of the Army, Navy, and Air Force","parent_excerpt":"confer and advise with the Secretary of Defense and the Secretaries of the Army, Navy, and Air Force","explanation":"The child adapts the same consultation mechanism and nearly identical cluster of defense officials."},{"child_excerpt":"All executive departments and agencies of the Federal Government are requested to cooperate with the Committee and to furnish it such available information as it may require for the performance of its duties.","parent_excerpt":"Agencies of the Government are requested to cooperate with the Committee and to furnish it such available information as it may require for the performance of its duties.","explanation":"This is nearly verbatim shared language."},{"child_excerpt":"The Selective Service System shall defray necessary expenses of the Committee, including the compensation of the members thereof, within limits of applicable law.","parent_excerpt":"The National Military Establishment and the Federal Security Agency shall defray such necessary expenses of the Committee as may be authorized by law","explanation":"Both conclude by assigning necessary committee expenses to the administering agencies, with the child adapting the payer and expressly addressing member compensation."}]}
